ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhpad_slot_guhmensi: Step through your guh portal into the Guhmension

This is the start of &6the Guh Path&r: the big stories open the worlds. First the &dGuhmension&r, then the &6Guhbarbecuether&r, then the &5Guh End&r. &dThis chapter isn't locked&r: step through your guh portal and you're there.

In your &6Super Compass&r, pick &dMy Story&r: it points to the nearest story you haven't done yet. The places themselves are in the &dTales&r tab.

The big stories of the Guhmension: &fNomguh&r in the white Snowguh Tundra (Baltoguh!), &5Clone Island&r in the Deep Guh Sea (Guhtwo!), the &dCloud Chapel&r high up in the clouds, the islands of &bGuhwai'i&r (626-guh!) and the &6dock cottage&r by the water, where the boat to &6Sniff Island&r leaves.

Followed them all? Then &dGuhdalf&r is waiting for you with the Nibble Ring and the next chapter opens. The &6Carpenter Guh&r, the surfing and the other rows here don't count for that: they're just here for fun. Here you can do everything in any order.
ftb.guhs_pad_barbecuether.q.guhpad_slot_:
&cThis chapter is locked&r until you've followed the big stories of the &dGuhmension&r. Below you can see which ones you already have: one tick per story. Still missing one? &dGuhdalf&r and the grill portal will tell you too, nyeg.

Got them all, and is the Grill Guh's barbecue burning again (&6WAHOOG, It's Burning Again!&r in &6The Guhbarbecuether&r)? Then there's a visitor at the big Barbecue Pit. &dGuhdalf&r has a ring-shaped nibble with him that makes everyone greedy. It has to go to &6Mount Fry&r, deep in the Guhbarbecuether: not to break it, but to fry it and share it. Only after his party does the grill portal let you through.

&6The Lord of the Nibble Ring&r is the only story where the quests &creally come one after another&r: follow them from top to bottom. Below it is &cSuper Guhrio&r: in a frying sauce sea stands &cBig Nether Mika's Castle&r (Super Compass: Barbecue). Inside you play everything &cfrom the side&r: A and D walk, space jumps. Falling costs nothing.

Your &dGuhdex&r (Tales tab) shows the whole Guh Path, and &dMy Story&r in your Super Compass always points the way.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guhpad_slot_guheinde: The Lord of the Nibble Ring

&cThis chapter is locked.&r The portal in the Nibble Cellar won't let you through until you've followed &6The Lord of the Nibble Ring&r and &cSuper Guhrio&r and have beaten the &cBurnt Mika&r. Below you can see what you already have: one tick per thing.

Have you been to the Guh End before? Whoever is still there may stay, but whoever steps out follows the rest of the Guh Path first. Everything you've already done simply stays saved, nyeg.

This story starts with two quests in &dThe Guhmension&r: &cThe Bigger the Mika...&r (Mikas, especially Big Mika, cry &5Mika Tears&r: you need those for the Eyes of Chonky) and &dLong Live the King!&r (the King Guh in the Guh Castle tells you where all the cheese nibbles went).

After that: twelve Eyes of Chonky, the Nibble Cellar and... Overlord Mika. Without nibbles your guh isn't WAHOOG, so go get them back! More stories will be added here later.

ftb.guhs_basis.q.intro_guhs_basis.desc:
You're already here! This is the very first chapter: every guh adventure starts here, with a handful of &6cheese nibbles&r.

Read the chapters from top to bottom: &dGuhs & Basics&r > &dThe Guhmension&r > &6Minigames & Special Places&r > &9Underwater&r > &cThe Guhbelly&r > &6The Guhbarbecuether&r > &eCaves, Swamp & Woods&r > &dSnuggledale&r > &dSqueak!&r > &dSweet Chonkies&r > &aCritters&r > &dGuhpixel&r > &bGuh Technology&r. The big stories are all together at the very bottom, in the group &6The Guh Path&r: &dTales of the Guhmension&r > &6Tales of the Guhbarbecuether&r > &5Tales of the Guh End&r > &7The Real Guh End&r.

At the top of every chapter there's a &dHow Do You Get Here?&r quest like this one, with a link to the quest in another chapter where it all starts.

Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work! (Only the belly sizes in The Guhbelly really come one after another, and in &6The Guh Path&r the big stories open the worlds: every chapter there starts with a lock quest.)
